name: SZBTechs AI Blog Writer for WooCommerce
author: szbtechs

sections.description:
SZBTechs AI Blog Writer writes helpful, search-optimised blog articles about your own WooCommerce products. Press Run now and it:

  1. Selects a product — published, in-stock products with a price and image; rotates so no product repeats inside the reuse window (default 14 days).
  2. Decides a topic — the AI proposes informational angles relevant to your market and picks the strongest one (never repeats a recent topic).
  3. Researches keywords — mines Google Autocomplete for your country and language (set in the Site profile) and picks one long-tail keyphrase, secondary keywords and FAQ questions.
  4. Builds links — 3–6 internal links (product, category, related posts, pillar URLs) and 2–4 external citations restricted to your authority whitelist (editable in Settings; defaults include WHO, NIH/PubMed, NHS, Wikipedia…).
  5. Writes the article (default 1000–1200 words) under a machine-checked SEO rule pack: title and meta length, keyphrase placement and density, heading hierarchy, clean slug, linking, image alt text, safety (no medical claims) and title uniqueness.
  6. Adds images — the product photo becomes the featured image, with keyword-rich alt text.
  7. Saves the article — as a draft in the review queue with the full rule checklist (publish, edit or delete it with one click), or, if you turn on Auto-publish, publishes it straight away when every rule passes. Articles that fail a rule always stay drafts.

It writes with the AI provider you connected in WordPress itself (the WordPress AI Client, WordPress 7.0+), so no extra key is needed. On sites without the WordPress AI Client you can use your own Groq API key instead (Groq offers a free tier).

Security by design: AI output is treated as untrusted (all HTML is filtered with wp_kses_post, the post author is never taken from AI text), outbound requests use wp_safe_remote_request, every admin action is nonce- and capability-checked, and only posts created by the plugin can be published or deleted from its queue.

Pro edition

A separate paid plugin, SZBTechs AI Blog Writer Pro, adds a daily schedule, several posts per run, SZBTechs Cloud AI models or other AI providers, AI hero images, People-Also-Ask and Google Trends keyword data, an extended AEO/GEO rule pack with automatic repair passes, Article and FAQ JSON-LD schema, and settings export/import. This plugin is complete on its own and never asks for a license.

External services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services. Nothing is sent until you press Run now.

  • WordPress AI Client — used when “WordPress AI” is selected, or with the default “Automatic” setting when a provider that can write text is connected in WordPress 7.0+; the prompts below go to whichever AI provider you connected in WordPress (Settings → AI), under that provider’s terms.
  • Groq API (api.groq.com) — used when “Groq” is selected, or with “Automatic” when WordPress AI has no text provider; writes topics, keywords (fallback) and articles. Sent: your API key, the selected product’s name, categories, price and description, and the generated prompts. Terms · Privacy
  • Google Autocomplete (suggestqueries.google.com) — keyword suggestions. Sent: short search phrases derived from the product and topic, plus your country/language codes. Terms · Privacy
  • Cited websites — each external link in a generated article receives one HEAD/GET request to check it is not broken. Sent: a standard HTTP request with no personal data.
  • Your product image URLs — downloaded once to attach the featured image to the post.
sections.installation:
1. Install from Plugins → Add New (search “SZBTechs AI Blog Writer”), or upload the zip.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active with at least one published, in-stock product that has a price and an image.
  3. Go to AI Blog Writer → Settings → AI provider: keep WordPress AI (WordPress 7.0+ with an AI provider connected), or choose Groq and add a Groq API key (https://console.groq.com/keys). The default Groq model is openai/gpt-oss-120b; use any active model on your Groq account.
  4. Check the Site profile (brand, author, country, currency, Google geo/language) and, if you like, your citation whitelist.
  5. On the dashboard press Run now, review the draft in the queue, then press Publish.
sections.faq:
Will it publish without my approval?

Only if you turn on Auto-publish (Settings → Publishing, or the switch on the dashboard). Then articles that pass every rule are published automatically; articles that fail any rule are always kept as drafts. With Auto-publish off (the default) every article waits in the review queue.

What if the AI provider is down or my quota is used up?

The run stops, the error is shown in the run log, and nothing is published. Press Run now again later.

Why does a run take a few minutes?

A run makes several AI and web requests. It continues on the server in the background and the dashboard shows its progress, so you can leave the page. If a run is stopped by your host’s PHP time or memory limit, the dashboard says so; check the PHP error log.

Are the articles safe for health & beauty stores?

The prompt forbids medical claims (cures, diagnoses, “100% effective”, replacing a doctor), a disclaimer is appended to every post, and a safety rule scans the final text for violations.
sections.changelog:
1.2.4

  • New “Automatic” AI provider setting (the default): uses WordPress AI when a provider that can write text is connected, otherwise your Groq key.
  • Fix: runs no longer fail with “No AI provider connected in WordPress supports text generation” when WordPress AI has no provider but a Groq key is set.
  • The settings page shows whether WordPress AI is ready.

1.2.3

  • Fix: “Save settings”, “Publish” and “New image” could stay on “Saving…” without submitting in Chrome and other browsers.

1.2.2

  • New name: SZBTechs AI Blog Writer for WooCommerce.
  • The WordPress AI Client is now the default AI provider on WordPress 7.0+; Groq remains available for other sites.
  • Auto-publish setting: publish articles that pass every rule automatically (off by default).
  • The citation whitelist is editable in Settings.
  • Run now continues in the background with live progress, so hosts and CDNs with request time limits no longer cut a run off.
  • Fix: fatal error when two copies of the plugin were installed at the same time.
  • Security: result messages in wp-admin are nonce-protected and shown only to users who can manage the plugin.

1.1.0

  • Keyword research locale follows the Site profile.
  • Fix: “Call to undefined function wp_strip_tags()” fatal error.
  • Fix: run failed on sites with existing posts.
  • Security: AI-generated HTML is always filtered; the post author is never derived from AI output; outbound requests use wp_safe_remote_request.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: pipeline, rule engine, images, dashboard and review queue.
